# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **v3 servicing release**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.5 brings Apple platform TFM support and a WinUI projection fix to the v3 line.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9** — Consumers targeting .NET 9 with WinUI no longer encounter a 'DLL not found' error for the WinUI projection assembly. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))

## Platform

- **Apple 26.0 library TFMs and unversioned app TFMs** — Apple targets now use the 26.0 version for library TFMs and the unversioned form for app TFMs, matching the Apple SDK conventions introduced in 4.148.0. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))
